items.headline: Virginia voters repeal same-sex marriage ban and restore voting rights after prison
items.summary: Virginians approved constitutional amendments removing the state's same-sex marriage ban and automatically restoring voting rights to people released from prison.
items.why_it_matters: Both measures expand civil rights written into the state constitution.

items.headline: World Bank finds India's extreme poverty fell from 27 percent to under 3 percent
items.summary: New World Bank figures show India's extreme poverty rate dropped from 27.1 percent in 2011 to 2.6 percent in 2023.
items.why_it_matters: It is one of the fastest poverty declines ever recorded, in the world's most populous country.
